changes: Preallocated Uint8Array and indexed charCodeAt preserve both original PNG byte lengths and SHA-256 without string-iterator intermediate list.
One application-window owner holds one immutable builtin pack, single-flight initial validation, at most two stable sheet URLs; view leases release without destroying this explicitly bounded cache.
Final non-BFCache pagehide or development HMR teardown invalidates the owner and releases resources. Failed attempts are disposed and a later lease can retry.
CatGirl retains its live-view guard and independent SVG fallback. Animation, prompt watermark, care, business data, PNG pixels and manifest budgets are unchanged.

unit.scope: Actual v4 two-sheet registry and window owner only; no unrelated complete suite.
assertions: Original two PNGs exact length/content/SHA after conversion
React-style released/live concurrent and 30 sequential leases share one loader, two decode/close pairs and stable URLs
Released/double cleanup cannot remove another lease
Second-sheet failure rolls back and next acquire retries
Final owner disposal during late second decode revokes staged URL and closes the late bitmap without revival
BFCache retains owner; terminal pagehide listener and URL release are idempotent

browser.server: Vite 7.1.9 source server at http://127.0.0.1:1421; not final release bundle
faultScenarios: view unmount while second bitmap pending, then reuse completed window cache with no view resurrection
owner disposal during pending second bitmap: late close, no resource revival
secondary PNG hash rejected: independent SVG fallback, then next lease retries
persisted BFCache pagehide does not dispose cache
browser.developmentTimer: Observed Vite client 30000ms heartbeat is explicitly retained in all samples; CatGirl 250ms interval disappears on unmount/hidden/reduced and returns once on resume. No native/process inference.

preservedEarlierObserverAttempts.reason: Old production-preview assertion expected all global intervals zero; development Vite 30000ms heartbeat remained. View itself was already unmounted; no product edit was made.
Runner re-added preload observer to the same Playwright Page, nesting held-decode wrappers. Final run uses a fresh browser Page and asserts exactly one installation. No product edit was made.

limitations: This does not establish WebView2/GPU cache reclamation or private-memory improvement.
C13 native lifecycle failure, startup private-memory peak and original raw evidence remain unchanged.
C14 requires a newly bound native candidate and the unchanged 30+30/four fixed windows, <=20MiB growth and <=350MiB gates; no such native run has happened here.
No final application build, native application launch, Core/desktop business or observer modification was performed in this renderer task.
Selected listener identities only; React delegated root listeners excluded; CSSAnimation counted separately from hover transitions.
